constraints.title: Capacity usage monitoring
constraints.requirement: Continuously measure and monitor current utilization of compute, storage, and network resources so that capacity constraints are detected before they threaten availability.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Confirm monitoring/telemetry exists for CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization with dashboards or metrics that reflect current usage against available capacity.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.1 (capacity monitoring and evaluation)

constraints.title: Capacity demand forecasting
constraints.requirement: Forecast future capacity demand and evaluate it against available resources to anticipate the need for scaling ahead of exhaustion.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Verify a documented process or model projects future demand (growth, seasonal peaks) and triggers capacity planning decisions.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.1 (evaluate capacity to meet demand)

constraints.title: Provisioning of additional capacity
constraints.requirement: Provide a mechanism to add or scale capacity (manually or via auto-scaling) so demand can be met without breaching availability commitments.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Confirm a defined path to provision extra capacity exists (auto-scaling policies, elastic infrastructure, or a documented procurement/scale-out runbook).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.1 (enable additional capacity)

constraints.title: Environmental threat protections
constraints.requirement: Implement protections against environmental hazards (fire, flooding, power loss, extreme temperature, humidity) affecting facilities or infrastructure hosting the system.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Verify environmental controls exist (fire suppression, UPS/generators, HVAC, water detection) or that the hosting provider attests to them in a shared-responsibility report.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.2 (environmental protections)

constraints.title: Environmental condition monitoring and alerting
constraints.requirement: Monitor environmental conditions and generate alerts on anomalies (temperature, power, smoke, moisture) so responders can act before an outage occurs.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Confirm environmental sensors/alerting are in place, or that the cloud/colocation provider supplies such monitoring per its compliance attestation.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.2 (detection of environmental issues)

constraints.title: Regular data backups
constraints.requirement: Perform regular backups of software and data on a defined schedule aligned with recovery objectives.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Verify backup jobs run on a documented schedule with a retention policy and evidence of recent successful completion.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.2 (data backup processes)

constraints.title: Backup protection and isolation
constraints.requirement: Protect backups from loss and tampering by storing copies in a separate location or region and encrypting them at rest.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Confirm backups are stored off-site or in a distinct region/account, are encrypted, and access to them is restricted.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.2 (recovery infrastructure and backup integrity)

constraints.title: Recovery infrastructure and redundancy
constraints.requirement: Maintain recovery infrastructure (redundancy, failover, or restorable environments) capable of restoring the system after a disruption within committed objectives.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Verify redundant components, failover targets, or a restorable recovery environment exist that align with the defined RTO/RPO.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.2 (recovery infrastructure)

constraints.title: Recovery objectives defined (RTO/RPO)
constraints.requirement: Define and document recovery time objectives (RTO) and recovery point objectives (RPO) that reflect the availability commitments made to customers.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Confirm documented RTO and RPO values exist and are traceable to service-level or availability commitments.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.2 / A1.3 (recovery objectives)

constraints.title: Business continuity / disaster recovery plan
constraints.requirement: Maintain a documented business continuity and disaster recovery plan describing roles, steps, and procedures to restore the system after a disruption.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Verify a current, approved BC/DR plan exists with defined responsibilities and recovery procedures.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.3 (recovery plan)

constraints.title: Recovery and backup restoration testing
constraints.requirement: Periodically test recovery procedures and restoration of backups to confirm the system can be recovered within defined objectives.
constraints.applies_when: System is scoped to the SOC 2 Availability trust services category
constraints.check: Confirm evidence of periodic DR tests and backup restore tests, including results and remediation of any gaps found.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC A1.3 (testing of recovery procedures)

constraints.title: Identify and classify confidential information
constraints.requirement: Establish criteria to identify information the entity has committed to keep confidential, and classify data at creation or receipt so it can be handled per its confidentiality level (C1.1 - identification of confidential information).
constraints.applies_when: Entity handles confidential (non-public proprietary or contractually protected) information and has adopted the Confidentiality trust services category.
constraints.check: Confirm a documented data classification scheme exists that defines a 'confidential' category and criteria, and that data is tagged/classified when created or ingested.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.1 - identifying and maintaining confidential information

constraints.title: Maintain inventory of confidential information and its locations
constraints.requirement: Maintain an inventory or record of confidential information assets and the systems, repositories, and third parties where they reside, so confidentiality obligations can be tracked (C1.1).
constraints.applies_when: Entity stores or processes classified confidential information across one or more systems.
constraints.check: Verify an asset/data inventory identifies confidential data stores and their locations and is kept current.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.1 - maintaining confidential information

constraints.title: Label or mark confidential information
constraints.requirement: Apply labeling or marking (physical or logical) to confidential information so users and systems can recognize and handle it according to its classification (C1.1).
constraints.applies_when: Entity has classified data as confidential.
constraints.check: Verify confidential records/documents carry classification labels or metadata tags that drive handling.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.1 - handling of confidential information

constraints.title: Protect confidential information throughout its retention period
constraints.requirement: Apply access controls, encryption, and other protections to confidential information for the full duration it is retained, restricting access to authorized parties (C1.1).
constraints.applies_when: Entity retains confidential information over time.
constraints.check: Verify access restrictions and protective controls (e.g., encryption, least-privilege access) are enforced on confidential data stores throughout retention.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.1 - protecting confidential information

constraints.title: Define retention periods aligned to commitments and requirements
constraints.requirement: Establish retention periods for confidential information consistent with the entity's confidentiality commitments, business objectives, and applicable legal or regulatory requirements (C1.1/C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Entity retains confidential information subject to commitments or legal obligations.
constraints.check: Verify a retention schedule/policy defines how long each class of confidential information is kept and the basis for those periods.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.1/C1.2 - retention of confidential information

constraints.title: Identify confidential information that has reached end of retention
constraints.requirement: Establish a process to identify confidential information that is no longer needed or has reached the end of its retention period so it can be scheduled for disposal (C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Entity retains confidential information subject to a retention schedule.
constraints.check: Verify a mechanism (review, automated flagging, or scheduled process) identifies confidential data eligible for disposal.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.2 - disposal of confidential information

constraints.title: Dispose of confidential information when no longer required
constraints.requirement: Dispose of confidential information in accordance with the retention policy once it is no longer needed to meet objectives or obligations (C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Entity holds confidential information that has passed its retention period or purpose.
constraints.check: Verify a documented disposal procedure exists and confidential data is removed per the retention schedule.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.2 - disposing of confidential information

constraints.title: Use secure and irreversible disposal methods
constraints.requirement: Use disposal methods that render confidential information unrecoverable, such as cryptographic erasure, secure wiping, or physical destruction of media (C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Entity disposes of confidential information in electronic or physical form.
constraints.check: Verify disposal procedures specify secure destruction/erasure techniques appropriate to the media and that they prevent recovery.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.2 - secure disposal methods

constraints.title: Dispose of all copies including backups and archives
constraints.requirement: Ensure disposal of confidential information covers all instances, including backups, archives, replicas, and derived copies, so no recoverable remnants persist (C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Confidential information is replicated to backups, archives, or secondary stores.
constraints.check: Verify disposal processes account for backup/archive/replica copies and confirm removal across all storage locations.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.2 - complete disposal of confidential information

constraints.title: Retain evidence of confidential information disposal
constraints.requirement: Record and retain evidence of disposal actions (what was destroyed, when, by whom, and by what method) to demonstrate compliance with disposal commitments (C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Entity performs disposal of confidential information.
constraints.check: Verify disposal logs, certificates of destruction, or equivalent records are generated and retained.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.2 - evidence of disposal

constraints.title: Impose confidentiality retention and disposal on third parties
constraints.requirement: Require vendors and third parties handling the entity's confidential information to meet equivalent retention and secure disposal obligations, typically through contractual terms (C1.1/C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Confidential information is shared with or processed by vendors, subprocessors, or other third parties.
constraints.check: Verify contracts or agreements with third parties include confidentiality, retention, and secure disposal/return obligations, and that adherence is monitored.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.1/C1.2 - third-party handling of confidential information

constraints.title: Return or destroy confidential information at contract termination
constraints.requirement: Ensure confidential information is returned or securely destroyed when a commitment, agreement, or relationship ends, consistent with confidentiality obligations (C1.2).
constraints.applies_when: Entity holds confidential information tied to a customer, partner, or vendor relationship that may terminate.
constraints.check: Verify offboarding/termination procedures trigger return or secure destruction of associated confidential information.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC C1.2 - disposal upon end of relationship

constraints.title: Code of conduct establishes integrity and ethics
constraints.requirement: The organization must define and communicate a documented code of conduct that sets expectations for integrity and ethical behavior across the entity.
constraints.check: Confirm a written code of conduct exists, is approved, and is distributed to all personnel with evidence of acknowledgement.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.1 (COSO Principle 1 - commitment to integrity and ethical values)

constraints.title: Ethics violations are evaluated and remediated
constraints.requirement: The organization must have a process to identify, evaluate, and address deviations from its ethics and conduct standards in a timely manner.
constraints.check: Verify a documented process exists for reporting, investigating, and remediating conduct violations, and review evidence of past cases being handled.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.1 (COSO Principle 1 - addressing deviations)

constraints.title: Board oversight independent of management
constraints.requirement: A board or governing body independent of management must exist and exercise oversight of the design and operation of internal controls.
constraints.check: Confirm a board or oversight body is established, includes members independent of management, and its oversight role is documented in a charter.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.2 (COSO Principle 2 - board independence and oversight)

constraints.title: Board possesses relevant expertise
constraints.requirement: The governing body must collectively hold the skills and expertise needed to oversee the organization's control environment and challenge management.
constraints.check: Review board member qualifications and evidence that oversight discussions cover security, risk, and compliance matters.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.2 (COSO Principle 2 - board expertise)

constraints.title: Organizational structure and reporting lines defined
constraints.requirement: Management must establish, with board oversight, an organizational structure with clear reporting lines that supports the achievement of control objectives.
constraints.check: Inspect an org chart and documentation defining reporting lines and structural responsibilities relevant to the system.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.3 (COSO Principle 3 - structures and reporting lines)

constraints.title: Authorities and responsibilities assigned
constraints.requirement: The organization must define and assign authorities and responsibilities for control activities to appropriate roles so duties are clearly owned.
constraints.check: Verify documented role definitions or responsibility matrices assign control ownership and decision authority to specific positions.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.3 (COSO Principle 3 - authority and responsibility)

constraints.title: Segregation of duties considered
constraints.requirement: Segregation of incompatible duties must be considered when assigning responsibilities so that no single individual can both perform and conceal errors or misuse.
constraints.applies_when: Handles sensitive operations, financial data, or privileged system access
constraints.check: Review responsibility assignments for conflicting duties and confirm mitigating controls where segregation is not feasible.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.3 (COSO Principle 3 - segregation of duties)

constraints.title: Competence requirements defined for roles
constraints.requirement: The organization must define the competence expected for each role relevant to internal control and use these as a basis for hiring and evaluation.
constraints.check: Confirm job descriptions or role definitions specify required skills and competencies for control-relevant positions.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.4 (COSO Principle 4 - commitment to competence)

constraints.title: Personnel are developed and trained
constraints.requirement: The organization must attract, develop, and retain competent personnel through training and development aligned with control objectives.
constraints.check: Review evidence of onboarding, security awareness, and ongoing training programs for staff in control-relevant roles.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.4 (COSO Principle 4 - develop and retain competence)

constraints.title: Succession and continuity planning for key roles
constraints.requirement: The organization should plan for succession and continuity of personnel in roles critical to internal control so control operation is not disrupted by turnover.
constraints.applies_when: Has key control-relevant roles or single points of personnel dependency
constraints.check: Verify documented succession or backup arrangements exist for critical control roles.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.4 (COSO Principle 4 - succession planning)

constraints.title: Individuals held accountable for control responsibilities
constraints.requirement: The organization must hold individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in pursuit of control objectives.
constraints.check: Confirm accountability mechanisms such as performance evaluations tied to control responsibilities are defined and applied.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.5 (COSO Principle 5 - enforce accountability)

constraints.title: Performance measures and incentives align with objectives
constraints.requirement: Performance measures, incentives, and rewards must be established and reviewed for ongoing relevance so they reinforce rather than undermine control objectives.
constraints.check: Review that performance and incentive structures reference control and compliance responsibilities and are periodically evaluated.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.5 (COSO Principle 5 - performance measures and incentives)

constraints.title: Consequences applied for accountability failures
constraints.requirement: The organization must apply appropriate consequences, including disciplinary action, when personnel fail to meet their internal control responsibilities.
constraints.check: Verify a documented disciplinary or corrective-action process exists and is enforced for control-responsibility failures.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC1.5 (COSO Principle 5 - corrective action)

constraints.title: Identify information requirements for internal control
constraints.requirement: The entity must define and identify the information needed to support the functioning of its internal control and the achievement of its security/service commitments and objectives.
constraints.check: Confirm there is a documented definition of the information requirements (data, sources, systems) needed to operate and monitor security controls.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.1 / COSO Principle 13 (relevant quality information)

constraints.title: Capture information from internal and external sources
constraints.requirement: The entity must capture relevant data from both internal and external sources and process it into information that supports internal control decisions.
constraints.check: Verify pipelines/logs/feeds exist that ingest internal and external data (e.g. system logs, threat feeds, vendor reports) into usable information.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.1 / COSO Principle 13

constraints.title: Ensure information quality (accuracy, timeliness, completeness)
constraints.requirement: Information used to run and monitor controls must be maintained at sufficient quality — accurate, current, complete, valid, and accessible — for the decisions it supports.
constraints.check: Inspect data-quality or validation processes ensuring monitoring information is accurate, timely, and complete before it drives control decisions.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.1 / COSO Principle 13

constraints.title: Internally communicate control objectives and responsibilities
constraints.requirement: The entity must internally communicate its objectives and each person's responsibilities for internal control so that personnel understand and can carry out their control duties.
constraints.check: Confirm documented communication (policies, role descriptions, onboarding material) that conveys security objectives and individual control responsibilities to staff.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.2 / COSO Principle 14 (internal communication)

constraints.title: Communicate security commitments and policies to personnel
constraints.requirement: The entity must communicate its security policies, commitments, and requirements to all internal users, including changes, so they know the standards they must follow.
constraints.check: Verify that security policies and any updates are distributed to personnel and acknowledged (e.g. policy acceptance, training records).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.2 / COSO Principle 14

constraints.title: Provide a channel to report failures, incidents, or concerns
constraints.requirement: The entity must maintain internal communication channels that allow personnel to report control failures, security incidents, non-compliance, or concerns, including a means for anonymous or confidential reporting.
constraints.check: Confirm a documented reporting mechanism (whistleblower line, incident/ticketing channel) exists for staff to raise control failures or concerns.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.2 / COSO Principle 14

constraints.title: Communicate control information between management and the board
constraints.requirement: Relevant internal-control and security information must flow between management and those charged with governance (e.g. the board or oversight body) to support their oversight duties.
constraints.applies_when: Entity has a board or governance/oversight body
constraints.check: Verify reporting cadence (e.g. security/risk updates to board or management committee) that conveys control status to governance.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.2 / COSO Principle 14

constraints.title: Communicate security commitments to external users and customers
constraints.requirement: The entity must communicate its security commitments and system responsibilities to external parties such as customers and users, including the obligations expected of those users.
constraints.applies_when: Provides a service or system to external users/customers
constraints.check: Confirm customer-facing artifacts (terms of service, security whitepaper, DPA, system description) that state security commitments and user responsibilities.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.3 / COSO Principle 15 (external communication)

constraints.title: Communicate relevant control information to vendors and business partners
constraints.requirement: The entity must communicate security objectives, requirements, and expectations to external vendors, partners, and other third parties whose actions affect its internal control.
constraints.applies_when: Relies on vendors, subservice organizations, or business partners
constraints.check: Verify that security requirements are conveyed to vendors/partners (e.g. contracts, SLAs, vendor security requirements documents).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.3 / COSO Principle 15

constraints.title: Provide external parties a channel to report issues and incidents
constraints.requirement: The entity must give external parties (customers, users, the public) a means to communicate relevant information, including reporting security incidents, vulnerabilities, or complaints.
constraints.applies_when: Provides a service or system to external users/customers
constraints.check: Confirm an external reporting channel exists (e.g. security@ contact, vulnerability disclosure page, support intake) for outside parties to report issues.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.3 / COSO Principle 15

constraints.title: Communicate system changes affecting external users
constraints.requirement: The entity must notify external users of changes to the system, its security commitments, or its responsibilities that could affect those users' use of the service.
constraints.applies_when: Provides a service or system to external users/customers
constraints.check: Verify a process for notifying customers/users of material system or commitment changes (e.g. changelog, status page, advance notices).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.3 / COSO Principle 15

constraints.title: Select appropriate methods and timing of communication
constraints.requirement: The entity must choose communication methods, formats, and timing appropriate to the audience and the sensitivity/urgency of the information for both internal and external communications.
constraints.check: Review the communication plan/procedures to confirm channels and timing are matched to audience and urgency (e.g. incident notification timelines, escalation paths).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC2.2 & CC2.3 / COSO Principles 14-15

constraints.title: Specify objectives with clarity
constraints.requirement: The entity must define its operational, reporting, and compliance objectives with enough specificity and clarity that risks to achieving them can be identified and assessed.
constraints.check: Confirm documented objectives (business/operational, financial/non-financial reporting, and regulatory compliance) exist and are specific enough to derive measurable risks from.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.1 / COSO Principle 6 (specify suitable objectives)

constraints.title: Set materiality and tolerances for objectives
constraints.requirement: When defining objectives, the entity should consider acceptable levels of variation (risk tolerance/materiality) so that risk assessment can be calibrated against them.
constraints.check: Verify that objectives include stated tolerances, thresholds, or materiality levels used to judge whether a risk is acceptable.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.1 / COSO Principle 6 (consider tolerances for risk)

constraints.title: Identify risks to objectives across the entity
constraints.requirement: The entity must identify risks to the achievement of its objectives at the entity, subsidiary, division, and functional levels, covering both internal and external sources.
constraints.check: Review a maintained risk register showing risks identified across relevant organizational levels and mapped to specific objectives.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.2 / COSO Principle 7 (identify and analyze risk)

constraints.title: Analyze likelihood and impact of risks
constraints.requirement: Identified risks must be analyzed by estimating their likelihood and potential impact (significance) to prioritize them for treatment.
constraints.check: Confirm each identified risk has a documented likelihood and impact rating and a resulting severity/priority.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.2 / COSO Principle 7 (analyze risks)

constraints.title: Determine risk responses
constraints.requirement: For analyzed risks the entity must decide how to respond, choosing among accepting, avoiding, reducing, or sharing the risk, and document the rationale.
constraints.check: Verify each significant risk has a documented response decision (accept/avoid/reduce/share) with an owner.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.2 / COSO Principle 7 (determine how to manage risks)

constraints.title: Involve appropriate management in risk assessment
constraints.requirement: Risk identification and analysis should engage appropriate levels of management with relevant knowledge of the objectives and processes involved.
constraints.check: Confirm risk assessment activities include documented participation or sign-off by responsible management stakeholders.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.2 / COSO Principle 7 (involve appropriate management)

constraints.title: Assess the potential for fraud
constraints.requirement: The entity must explicitly consider the potential for fraud when assessing risks to the achievement of its objectives.
constraints.check: Verify the risk assessment includes a documented fraud risk assessment component distinct from generic operational risks.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.3 / COSO Principle 8 (assess fraud risk)

constraints.title: Consider fraud incentives, opportunities, and rationalizations
constraints.requirement: Fraud risk assessment should evaluate incentives and pressures, opportunities (e.g., weak controls or override potential), and attitudes/rationalizations that could enable fraud.
constraints.check: Confirm the fraud risk assessment addresses the fraud-triangle factors: pressures/incentives, opportunities, and rationalizations.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.3 / COSO Principle 8 (consider incentives, opportunities, attitudes)

constraints.title: Consider multiple fraud types including management override
constraints.requirement: The fraud assessment must cover different fraud types such as fraudulent reporting, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and the risk of management overriding controls.
constraints.check: Verify the fraud risk assessment enumerates fraudulent reporting, asset misappropriation, corruption, and management-override scenarios.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.3 / COSO Principle 8 (types of fraud, management override)

constraints.title: Identify changes that could impact internal control
constraints.requirement: The entity must identify and assess changes in the external environment, business/operating model, leadership, and technology that could significantly affect its system of internal control.
constraints.check: Confirm a process exists that flags significant external, organizational, and technology changes and triggers reassessment of controls.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.4 / COSO Principle 9 (identify and assess significant change)

constraints.title: Feed change assessment into risk assessment
constraints.requirement: Significant identified changes must trigger an update of the risk assessment so that new or altered risks to objectives are re-analyzed and responded to.
constraints.check: Verify that change events (e.g., new systems, reorganizations, new regulations) are documented as inputs that led to updated risk analysis.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.4 / COSO Principle 9 (assess changes to internal control)

constraints.title: Assess control impact of technology and vendor changes
constraints.requirement: Changes to technology, infrastructure, or reliance on third-party vendors must be assessed for their effect on the design and operation of internal controls.
constraints.applies_when: Uses significant IT systems or relies on third-party/vendor services
constraints.check: Confirm the change assessment explicitly evaluates technology and vendor/subservice-organization changes for control impact.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC3.4 / COSO Principle 9 (technology and external provider changes)

constraints.title: Select and develop ongoing and separate evaluations
constraints.requirement: The organization defines and performs a mix of ongoing monitoring and periodic separate evaluations to confirm that the components of internal control are present and operating as intended.
constraints.check: Confirm the plan documents a monitoring program combining continuous/ongoing checks and scheduled point-in-time evaluations of controls, with defined scope and cadence.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1 (COSO Principle 16) - ongoing and separate evaluations

constraints.title: Baseline understanding of control design
constraints.requirement: Evaluators establish and reference a documented baseline of how controls are designed to operate so that evaluations can detect deviations from expected behavior.
constraints.check: Verify a current baseline (control descriptions, system boundaries, expected control operation) exists and is used as the reference point for monitoring.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1 - establishes baseline understanding

constraints.title: Tune monitoring to rate of change
constraints.requirement: The scope and frequency of separate evaluations are adjusted based on the risk level and the rate of change in the business, systems, and control environment.
constraints.check: Check that evaluation frequency/scope is risk-based and is reassessed when systems, personnel, or processes change materially.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1 - considers rate of change when scoping evaluations

constraints.title: Objective and knowledgeable evaluators
constraints.requirement: Separate evaluations are performed by personnel with sufficient knowledge and objectivity to assess control operation without evaluating their own work.
constraints.check: Confirm evaluators are competent and independent of the controls being assessed (e.g., internal audit or a separate function).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1 - objective, knowledgeable evaluators

constraints.title: Integrate monitoring into business processes
constraints.requirement: Ongoing monitoring activities are built into routine operations (e.g., automated alerts, reconciliations, exception reports) to provide near-real-time indication of control performance.
constraints.check: Verify the plan embeds automated or operational monitoring (alerts, dashboards, reconciliations) into day-to-day processes rather than relying solely on periodic reviews.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1 - ongoing evaluations built into processes

constraints.title: Monitor controls at service organizations / vendors
constraints.requirement: The organization monitors the effectiveness of controls operated by subservice organizations and vendors it relies on, for example by reviewing their SOC reports or performing due diligence.
constraints.applies_when: Relies on third-party service providers or subservice organizations
constraints.check: Confirm a process reviews vendor/subservice-org control reports (e.g., SOC 2) or equivalent assurance on a defined cadence.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1 - monitoring of outsourced/subservice controls

constraints.title: Evaluate and assess identified deficiencies
constraints.requirement: Results of ongoing and separate evaluations are assessed to identify control deficiencies and determine their severity and impact.
constraints.check: Verify a process exists to evaluate monitoring results, log deficiencies, and rate their severity/impact.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.2 (COSO Principle 17) - evaluates deficiencies

constraints.title: Communicate deficiencies to responsible parties
constraints.requirement: Identified control deficiencies are communicated to the parties responsible for corrective action and to senior management or the board as appropriate.
constraints.check: Confirm deficiencies are reported to remediation owners and escalated to management/board per defined criteria.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.2 - communicates deficiencies to remediation owners and leadership

constraints.title: Track remediation to completion
constraints.requirement: Corrective actions for identified deficiencies are assigned, tracked, and monitored to confirm timely remediation.
constraints.check: Verify a remediation tracking mechanism exists with owners, due dates, and follow-up until deficiencies are resolved and verified.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.2 - monitors corrective actions to completion

constraints.title: Escalation of significant deficiencies
constraints.requirement: Deficiencies deemed significant are escalated in a timely manner to senior management and the board or those charged with governance for oversight.
constraints.check: Confirm the plan defines severity thresholds that trigger timely escalation of significant deficiencies to governance-level oversight.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.2 - escalation of significant matters to leadership/board

constraints.title: Document and retain evaluation results
constraints.requirement: The organization documents and retains the results of monitoring evaluations and deficiency findings to provide evidence of ongoing oversight.
constraints.check: Verify monitoring results, findings, and remediation status are documented and retained as auditable evidence.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC4.1/CC4.2 - documentation of monitoring and evaluation results

constraints.title: Select and develop control activities aligned to risk
constraints.requirement: Select and develop control activities that reduce risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels, integrating the selection with the outputs of the risk assessment process.
constraints.check: Confirm each identified risk from the risk assessment maps to one or more control activities documented in a risk-to-control matrix.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.1 (COSO Principle 10) - select and develop control activities

constraints.title: Consider entity-specific factors in control design
constraints.requirement: Design control activities that account for the entity's specific environment, complexity, business processes, and the nature and scope of its operations.
constraints.check: Review control design documentation for evidence that entity-specific factors (size, complexity, processes) were considered when selecting controls.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.1 - considers entity-specific factors

constraints.title: Identify relevant business processes for controls
constraints.requirement: Determine which business processes require control activities and where in those processes controls should be applied to mitigate risk.
constraints.check: Verify that controls are mapped to the specific business processes and process steps where risks are addressed.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.1 - determines relevant business processes

constraints.title: Use a balanced mix of control types
constraints.requirement: Employ a combination of control activity types, including manual and automated as well as preventive and detective controls, to address risks appropriately.
constraints.check: Inspect the control inventory to confirm it includes a mix of preventive/detective and manual/automated controls rather than a single type.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.1 - evaluates a mix of control activity types

constraints.title: Enforce segregation of duties
constraints.requirement: Consider and implement segregation of incompatible duties so that no single individual can both perform and conceal errors or fraud; where segregation is impractical, implement compensating controls.
constraints.check: Review role/permission assignments and approval workflows for separation of conflicting responsibilities, and confirm compensating controls exist where segregation is not feasible.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.1 - addresses segregation of duties

constraints.title: Determine technology dependency of processes
constraints.requirement: Identify the dependencies between the technology used in business processes and the technology general controls needed to support reliable operation of that technology.
constraints.applies_when: Business processes rely on IT systems or automated processing
constraints.check: Confirm a mapping exists linking automated business-process controls to the underlying technology general controls they depend on.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.2 (COSO Principle 11) - determines dependency between technology and general controls

constraints.title: Establish technology infrastructure controls
constraints.requirement: Select and develop general control activities over technology infrastructure to support the completeness, accuracy, and availability of processing.
constraints.applies_when: Operates or relies on IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud)
constraints.check: Verify documented infrastructure controls (e.g., configuration, capacity, availability monitoring) are in place and operating.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.2 - establishes relevant technology infrastructure control activities

constraints.title: Establish security management process controls
constraints.requirement: Select and develop general control activities over the security management process, including access authorization and restriction to authorized users, to protect against unauthorized access.
constraints.applies_when: Systems process or store data requiring protection
constraints.check: Confirm access management controls (provisioning, authentication, authorization, restriction) are defined and enforced over relevant systems.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.2 - establishes relevant security management process control activities

constraints.title: Control technology acquisition, development, and maintenance
constraints.requirement: Select and develop control activities over the acquisition, development, and maintenance of technology and its infrastructure to achieve objectives.
constraints.applies_when: Develops, acquires, or maintains software or systems
constraints.check: Review SDLC and change-management procedures for controls governing technology acquisition, development, and maintenance.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.2 - establishes technology acquisition, development, and maintenance controls

constraints.title: Deploy controls through documented policies and procedures
constraints.requirement: Establish policies that state what is expected and procedures that put those policies into action, so control activities are deployed consistently across the entity.
constraints.check: Verify that control activities are backed by documented, approved policies and corresponding operating procedures.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.3 (COSO Principle 12) - establishes policies and procedures to support deployment

constraints.title: Assign responsibility and accountability for controls
constraints.requirement: Establish responsibility and accountability for executing each policy and procedure with the personnel or roles responsible for the related control activity.
constraints.check: Confirm each control/policy names an accountable owner or role responsible for its execution.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.3 - establishes responsibility and accountability for executing policies and procedures

constraints.title: Perform control activities timely and take corrective action
constraints.requirement: Perform control activities in a timely manner as defined by policy and investigate and act on matters identified as a result of executing the control activity.
constraints.check: Review evidence that controls run on their defined cadence and that exceptions or issues trigger documented corrective action.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.3 - performs in a timely manner and takes corrective action

constraints.title: Use competent personnel and periodically reassess controls
constraints.requirement: Ensure control activities are performed by personnel with sufficient competence and authority, and periodically reassess policies and procedures for continued relevance, updating them as needed.
constraints.check: Confirm control operators meet competency requirements and that policies/procedures are reviewed on a defined schedule and updated when conditions change.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC5.3 - uses competent personnel and reassesses policies and procedures

constraints.title: Logical access controls over protected assets (CC6.1)
constraints.requirement: Implement logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures that restrict access to information assets to authorized identities, protecting them from unauthorized use, disclosure, or modification.
constraints.check: Confirm the plan defines an authentication/authorization layer that gates access to systems and data, with an inventory of protected assets and the controls guarding each.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.1 - logical access security measures for protected information assets

constraints.title: Unique identity and credential management (CC6.1)
constraints.requirement: Assign each user and system a unique identifier and manage credentials (issuance, rotation, revocation) so that actions can be attributed and shared/generic accounts are avoided.
constraints.check: Verify each account maps to a single identity, shared logins are prohibited, and a documented credential lifecycle (creation, rotation, revocation) exists.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.1 - identification and authentication of users via unique credentials

constraints.title: Strong authentication for sensitive or remote access (CC6.1)
constraints.requirement: Require multi-factor authentication or equivalently strong authentication for privileged, remote, and externally exposed access paths.
constraints.applies_when: Exposes remote/admin access or handles sensitive data
constraints.check: Confirm MFA is enforced for administrative, VPN/remote, and internet-facing authenticated access.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.1 - authentication strength for access to protected assets

constraints.title: Encryption of data at rest (CC6.1)
constraints.requirement: Protect stored sensitive information with encryption and manage the associated cryptographic keys securely throughout their lifecycle.
constraints.check: Verify at-rest encryption is specified for sensitive datastores and that key management (storage, rotation, access restriction) is defined.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.1 - encryption and key management for data at rest

constraints.title: Authorized user registration and provisioning (CC6.2)
constraints.requirement: Register and authorize new internal and external users through a documented approval process before granting credentials, and grant access only after authorization.
constraints.check: Confirm an access-request/approval workflow exists that authorizes users prior to credential issuance and records the approval.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.2 - registration and authorization of new users prior to access

constraints.title: Timely deprovisioning of access (CC6.2/CC6.3)
constraints.requirement: Remove or disable access promptly when users leave, change roles, or no longer require it, so that credentials do not outlive the business need.
constraints.check: Verify a deprovisioning procedure ties termination/role-change events to prompt access removal, with a defined SLA and periodic verification.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.2/CC6.3 - removal of access upon termination or change of role

constraints.title: Role-based access and least privilege (CC6.3)
constraints.requirement: Grant, modify, and remove access based on roles and the principle of least privilege, and enforce segregation of duties for sensitive functions.
constraints.check: Confirm access is assigned via defined roles scoped to minimum necessary permissions, and that conflicting duties are separated.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.3 - role-based, least-privilege authorization and segregation of duties

constraints.title: Periodic access review and recertification (CC6.3)
constraints.requirement: Review user and privileged access rights on a recurring basis to confirm they remain appropriate, and revoke any that are no longer justified.
constraints.check: Verify a scheduled access-review/recertification process exists (owner, cadence, evidence) covering standard and privileged accounts.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.3 - periodic review of access appropriateness

constraints.title: Physical access restriction to facilities and assets (CC6.4)
constraints.requirement: Restrict physical access to facilities, data centers, and hardware housing protected information to authorized personnel, and review physical access rights periodically.
constraints.applies_when: Operates own facilities/data centers or on-premise hardware
constraints.check: Confirm physical access controls (badges, locks, visitor logs) and periodic physical-access reviews are defined; for cloud-hosted systems, confirm provider physical controls are inherited via the vendor's attestation.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.4 - physical access controls to protected facilities and assets

constraints.title: Secure disposal and data removal from assets (CC6.5)
constraints.requirement: Securely erase or destroy data and decommission physical and logical assets before disposal or reuse so that residual sensitive information cannot be recovered.
constraints.applies_when: Retires, reuses, or disposes of media or assets holding data
constraints.check: Verify a media sanitization/asset-disposal procedure specifies secure erasure or destruction methods and records completion.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.5 - removal of data before asset disposal or reuse

constraints.title: Network boundary protection (CC6.6)
constraints.requirement: Deploy boundary protection controls (firewalls, network segmentation, intrusion detection/prevention) to defend against threats from outside the system boundary.
constraints.applies_when: Exposes systems to untrusted networks or the internet
constraints.check: Confirm the architecture defines perimeter controls, network segmentation, and monitoring at trust boundaries between internal and external networks.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.6 - protection against threats from sources outside system boundaries

constraints.title: Encryption of data in transit (CC6.7)
constraints.requirement: Protect sensitive information moving over networks or removable media using encryption and restrict how and where such data can be transmitted or transported.
constraints.applies_when: Transmits sensitive data over networks or external channels
constraints.check: Verify TLS/strong encryption is enforced for data in transit and that controls govern movement of data to removable media or external endpoints.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.7 - restriction and encryption of data in transmission and movement

constraints.title: Prevention and detection of unauthorized software (CC6.8)
constraints.requirement: Implement controls to prevent, detect, and remediate the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software into the environment.
constraints.check: Confirm anti-malware, allowlisting/change controls, and integrity monitoring are defined to block and detect unauthorized software.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC6.8 - controls against unauthorized and malicious software

constraints.title: Vulnerability detection via configuration baselines
constraints.requirement: CC7.1 - Define and use detection and monitoring procedures that identify changes to configurations which introduce new vulnerabilities, and scan infrastructure and software for known vulnerabilities on a defined schedule.
constraints.check: Confirm the plan defines a configuration baseline and runs scheduled vulnerability scans (e.g. authenticated scans, dependency/SCA scanning) against systems and code, with results tracked.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.1 (detection of config changes and vulnerabilities)

constraints.title: Continuous monitoring for anomalies
constraints.requirement: CC7.2 - Continuously monitor system components and their operation for anomalies that could indicate malicious activity, processing errors, or other conditions that threaten the system's ability to meet its objectives.
constraints.check: Verify monitoring/telemetry (logs, metrics, IDS/EDR, cloud monitoring) covers key components and is actively watched, not just collected.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.2 (monitoring for anomalous activity)

constraints.title: Alerting thresholds and detection tooling
constraints.requirement: CC7.2 - Implement detection tools with defined alerting criteria and thresholds so that anomalous or suspicious events generate timely, actionable alerts to responsible personnel.
constraints.check: Confirm alert rules/thresholds are configured, route to an owner or on-call, and generate notifications for security-relevant events.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.2 (detection tooling and alerts)

constraints.title: Evaluate and triage security events
constraints.requirement: CC7.3 - Evaluate detected security events to determine whether they constitute an incident that could prevent meeting objectives, and assign a severity so response can be prioritized.
constraints.check: Verify a documented triage/severity classification process exists that distinguishes events from incidents and prioritizes them.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.3 (evaluate events as incidents)

constraints.title: Documented incident response plan
constraints.requirement: CC7.4 - Maintain a documented incident response plan that defines roles, responsibilities, communication paths, and response procedures for handling identified security incidents.
constraints.check: Confirm an incident response plan/runbook exists naming roles, escalation contacts, and step-by-step response actions.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.4 (incident response program)

constraints.title: Contain, remediate, and mitigate incidents
constraints.requirement: CC7.4 - Execute response procedures to contain, eradicate, and mitigate identified security incidents so their impact is limited and recurrence is reduced.
constraints.check: Verify the plan includes containment and eradication steps and assigns remediation ownership with tracking to closure.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.4 (contain and remediate incidents)

constraints.title: Incident communication and breach notification
constraints.requirement: CC7.4 - Define internal and external communication procedures for incidents, including notifying affected customers, regulators, and stakeholders within required timeframes when applicable.
constraints.applies_when: Processes customer data or has contractual/regulatory notification obligations
constraints.check: Confirm the plan specifies who is notified, by when, and through what channel for qualifying incidents (including breach notification).
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.4 (incident communication)

constraints.title: Recovery from incidents
constraints.requirement: CC7.5 - Identify, develop, and implement activities to recover from identified security incidents and restore affected systems and data to normal operation.
constraints.check: Verify recovery procedures (including restoration from backups where relevant) are defined and can return systems to a known-good state.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.5 (recovery activities)

constraints.title: Post-incident review and lessons learned
constraints.requirement: CC7.5 - After significant incidents, perform a post-incident review to determine root cause and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence.
constraints.check: Confirm a post-incident/root-cause review process exists and feeds corrective actions back into controls.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.5 (post-incident improvement)

constraints.title: Remediate identified vulnerabilities within SLA
constraints.requirement: CC7.1 - Track vulnerabilities identified through scanning and monitoring to resolution, prioritizing remediation by risk severity within defined timeframes.
constraints.check: Verify vulnerabilities are logged with severity and remediation SLAs, and that patching/mitigation is tracked to closure.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.1 (vulnerability remediation)

constraints.title: Log retention supporting detection and investigation
constraints.requirement: CC7.2/CC7.3 - Retain security-relevant logs for a sufficient period and protect their integrity so that anomalies can be detected and incidents can be investigated after the fact.
constraints.check: Confirm logs are centrally retained for a defined period, access-controlled, and tamper-resistant to support forensic investigation.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.2/CC7.3 (logging for detection and analysis)

constraints.title: Test the incident response plan periodically
constraints.requirement: CC7.4 - Periodically test or exercise the incident response plan (e.g. tabletop or simulation) to validate that procedures work and responders understand their roles.
constraints.check: Verify the plan is exercised on a defined cadence and findings from tests are used to update procedures.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 TSC CC7.4 (incident response testing)

constraints.title: Formal change management process
constraints.requirement: Maintain a defined, repeatable change management process governing how changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures are authorized, designed, developed or acquired, configured, documented, tested, approved, and implemented.
constraints.check: Confirm a documented change management policy/procedure exists and is referenced by the actual change workflow (e.g., ticketing system) used for production changes.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 (2017 TSC) - change management process

constraints.title: Change authorization / request
constraints.requirement: Require that every change be formally requested and authorized before work begins, so unauthorized or ad-hoc changes to production systems are prevented.
constraints.check: Verify each production change has an authorized request record (ticket) capturing requester, description, and authorization prior to development.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - authorize changes

constraints.title: Design and impact assessment of changes
constraints.requirement: Assess and document the design, scope, and potential impact of a change (including security and availability effects) before it is developed and deployed.
constraints.check: Confirm change records include a design/impact assessment section that is completed before build, covering affected systems and risks.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - design changes

constraints.title: Testing before deployment
constraints.requirement: Test changes prior to production deployment to confirm they function as intended and do not introduce defects, security weaknesses, or regressions.
constraints.check: Verify change records show test evidence (test results, QA sign-off, CI runs) completed before promotion to production.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - test changes

constraints.title: Approval before implementation
constraints.requirement: Require documented approval from an authorized party (independent of the developer where feasible) before a change is released into production.
constraints.check: Confirm each production change carries a recorded approval by an authorized approver, dated before deployment.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - approve and implement changes

constraints.title: Segregation of duties in the change pipeline
constraints.requirement: Separate the roles of developing, approving, and deploying changes so that no single individual can author and unilaterally release a production change without independent review.
constraints.check: Verify deployment controls (e.g., branch protection, required reviewers, CI/CD gates) prevent the same person from authoring, approving, and deploying a change unchecked.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - segregation within change management

constraints.title: Version control and change tracking
constraints.requirement: Track code and configuration changes under version control so each change is attributable, auditable, and its history reconstructable.
constraints.applies_when: System is software/infrastructure with code or config artifacts
constraints.check: Confirm source and infrastructure config are managed in a version control system with commit history tied to authorized change records.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - configure and document changes

constraints.title: Change documentation
constraints.requirement: Document each change with sufficient detail (what changed, why, who, when, test and approval evidence) to support review and audit.
constraints.check: Sample change tickets and confirm they capture description, rationale, actors, dates, and links to test/approval evidence.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - document changes

constraints.title: Segregation of development and production environments
constraints.requirement: Develop and test changes in environments separate from production so untested changes and non-production data cannot affect live systems.
constraints.check: Verify separate dev/test and production environments exist with controlled promotion between them and no direct dev edits to production.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - configure/deploy changes across environments

constraints.title: Emergency change procedure
constraints.requirement: Define an emergency/expedited change path that still requires post-implementation review and documented retroactive approval, so urgent fixes remain controlled.
constraints.applies_when: System supports emergency or hotfix changes
constraints.check: Confirm an emergency change procedure exists requiring documentation and after-the-fact approval, and review that emergency changes followed it.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - controlled emergency changes

constraints.title: Rollback / backout capability
constraints.requirement: Provide a documented rollback or backout plan for changes so a failed or defective deployment can be reverted to a known good state.
constraints.applies_when: Change affects production availability or integrity
constraints.check: Verify change records include a rollback plan and that deployment tooling supports reverting to the prior version.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - implement changes with recovery

constraints.title: Baseline configuration management
constraints.requirement: Establish and maintain approved baseline configurations for infrastructure and software, and manage deviations from baseline through the change process.
constraints.applies_when: System has configurable infrastructure or software components
constraints.check: Confirm baseline configurations are defined (e.g., IaC, hardening standards) and that config drift is detected and reconciled via change control.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - configure infrastructure and software

constraints.title: Security review of changes
constraints.requirement: Incorporate security review (e.g., code review, vulnerability/dependency scanning) into the change process so changes do not introduce or reintroduce security weaknesses.
constraints.applies_when: System processes sensitive data or exposes network-accessible services
constraints.check: Verify the pipeline enforces security checks (peer review, SAST/dependency scan) as gates before changes reach production.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC8.1 - develop/test secure changes

constraints.title: Identify risks from potential business disruptions
constraints.requirement: CC9.1 - The entity must identify risks that could arise from potential business disruptions and select mitigation activities to address them.
constraints.check: Confirm a documented process exists that enumerates business-disruption scenarios (e.g., outages, disasters, supply-chain failures) and links each to selected mitigation activities.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.1 (Risk mitigation for business disruptions)

constraints.title: Develop and implement risk-mitigation activities
constraints.requirement: CC9.1 - The entity must develop and put in place mitigation activities (controls, redundancy, response plans) proportionate to the identified disruption risks.
constraints.check: Verify mitigation controls (e.g., backups, failover, contingency plans) are implemented and mapped to the disruption risks they address.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.1 (Develop mitigation activities)

constraints.title: Consider insurance and risk-transfer options
constraints.requirement: CC9.1 - The entity should consider risk-transfer mechanisms such as insurance as part of its mitigation strategy for residual disruption risk.
constraints.check: Check whether risk-transfer options (insurance coverage, contractual indemnities) were evaluated and documented for residual risks.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.1 (Risk transfer / insurance)

constraints.title: Maintain a vendor and business-partner inventory
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must maintain an inventory of vendors and business partners whose services could affect the security or availability of the system.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Confirm a maintained register of vendors/business partners exists identifying which handle or affect in-scope data and services.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Vendor identification)

constraints.title: Assess vendor and partner risk before and during engagement
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must assess the risks that vendors and business partners pose, both during onboarding and on an ongoing basis.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Verify documented risk assessments (e.g., due-diligence reviews, security questionnaires) exist for vendors at onboarding and are refreshed periodically.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Vendor risk assessment)

constraints.title: Define vendor responsibilities in contracts and agreements
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must establish agreements that define vendors' and business partners' security, confidentiality, and availability responsibilities.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Inspect contracts/SLAs/DPAs to confirm they specify security, confidentiality, and service commitments for each material vendor.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Vendor contractual commitments)

constraints.title: Communicate entity requirements to vendors
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must communicate its security, confidentiality, and compliance requirements to relevant vendors and business partners.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Confirm evidence that vendor obligations, policies, or requirements were formally communicated to and acknowledged by vendors.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Vendor communication)

constraints.title: Monitor ongoing vendor and partner performance and compliance
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must monitor vendors and business partners for continued compliance with its requirements and for changes in their risk profile.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Verify ongoing monitoring occurs (e.g., review of vendor SOC 2 reports, attestations, performance reviews) on a defined cadence.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Ongoing vendor monitoring)

constraints.title: Assess and manage subservice-organization risk
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must assess risks arising from subservice organizations relied upon by its vendors and confirm those risks are managed.
constraints.applies_when: Relies on vendors that use subservice organizations
constraints.check: Confirm the entity identifies fourth-party/subservice dependencies and reviews the controls (e.g., carve-out/complementary controls) covering them.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Subservice organization risk)

constraints.title: Define procedures for vendor termination and offboarding
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must have procedures to manage the risks of ending a vendor or business-partner relationship, including data return or destruction and access revocation.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Verify offboarding procedures exist requiring revocation of vendor access and return/destruction of entity data at termination.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Vendor termination / offboarding)

constraints.title: Take corrective action on identified vendor deficiencies
constraints.requirement: CC9.2 - The entity must respond to and remediate deficiencies or noncompliance identified in vendor or business-partner risk assessments and monitoring.
constraints.applies_when: Uses third-party vendors or business partners
constraints.check: Check for a documented process that tracks vendor deficiencies to remediation, escalation, or relationship termination.
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 CC9.2 (Corrective action on vendor issues)

constraints.title: Privacy notice of objectives and practices
constraints.requirement: Publish a privacy notice describing the entity's objectives for collecting, using, retaining, disclosing, and disposing of personal information, so data subjects understand how their data is handled.
constraints.applies_when: Handles personal data (PII) and the SOC 2 Privacy category is in scope
constraints.check: Confirm a documented privacy notice exists that enumerates purposes for collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P1.1 (notice and communication of objectives)

constraints.title: Notice timing and updates
constraints.requirement: Provide the privacy notice at or before the point of personal information collection and re-communicate it whenever privacy practices materially change.
constraints.check: Verify collection flows surface the notice before/at capture and that a change-management process re-issues notice on practice changes.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P1.1 (notice provided timely and on change)

constraints.title: Choice and consent for collection and use
constraints.requirement: Communicate the choices available to data subjects and obtain their consent for the collection, use, retention, and disclosure of personal information consistent with the stated objectives.
constraints.check: Confirm a consent capture mechanism records the data subject's choice tied to specific purposes and that consent is retained as evidence.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P2.1 (choice and consent)

constraints.title: Explicit consent for sensitive data
constraints.requirement: Obtain explicit (affirmative) consent before collecting or processing sensitive categories of personal information, and document the basis for that consent.
constraints.applies_when: Processes sensitive personal information (e.g. health, biometric, financial, racial/ethnic, religious data)
constraints.check: Verify sensitive-data workflows require a distinct explicit opt-in that is logged separately from general consent.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P2.1 (explicit consent for sensitive information)

constraints.title: Collection limited to stated purposes
constraints.requirement: Collect only personal information that is necessary for the purposes identified in the notice, using fair and lawful means.
constraints.check: Map each collected data field to a documented purpose and confirm no data is gathered beyond those purposes.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P3.1 (collection consistent with objectives)

constraints.title: Consent for data from third-party sources
constraints.requirement: When personal information is obtained from sources other than the individual, ensure the source had authority to provide it and that use aligns with the entity's stated purposes.
constraints.applies_when: Acquires personal data from third parties or data brokers rather than directly from the individual
constraints.check: Confirm contracts or attestations exist for third-party data sources establishing lawful provenance and permitted use.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P3.2 (collection from third parties / explicit consent)

constraints.title: Use limited to consented purposes
constraints.requirement: Use personal information only for the purposes identified in the notice and for which the data subject has provided consent.
constraints.check: Review processing activities and confirm each use maps to a purpose disclosed in the notice and covered by consent.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P4.1 (use consistent with purposes)

constraints.title: Retention limited to necessity
constraints.requirement: Retain personal information only for as long as needed to fulfill the stated purposes or to meet legal/regulatory obligations, per a defined retention schedule.
constraints.check: Verify a documented retention schedule exists and that automated or reviewed deletion enforces retention limits.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P4.2 (retention for identified purposes)

constraints.title: Secure disposal of personal information
constraints.requirement: Securely and irreversibly dispose of or anonymize personal information once retention requirements are met, preventing later recovery.
constraints.check: Confirm disposal procedures (secure deletion, media destruction, anonymization) exist and produce evidence of execution.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P4.3 (disposal of personal information)

constraints.title: Data subject access to their information
constraints.requirement: Provide data subjects a means to access their personal information held by the entity for review, upon authenticated request.
constraints.check: Verify an access-request process exists that authenticates the requester and returns their personal data within a defined timeframe.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P5.1 (access to personal information)

constraints.title: Correction, amendment, and deletion of information
constraints.requirement: Allow data subjects to update, correct, amend, or request deletion of their personal information, and act on such requests, notifying relevant third parties where required.
constraints.check: Confirm a workflow accepts correction/deletion requests, applies changes, and propagates them to downstream recipients.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P5.2 (correction and amendment)

constraints.title: Disclosure limited to authorized recipients
constraints.requirement: Disclose personal information to third parties only for purposes covered by the notice and consent, and only under agreements requiring equivalent privacy protection.
constraints.applies_when: Discloses or shares personal data with third parties or subprocessors
constraints.check: Verify third-party disclosures map to consented purposes and are governed by contracts imposing equivalent privacy and confidentiality obligations.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P6.1 / P6.2 (disclosure to third parties)

constraints.title: Notification of unauthorized disclosure
constraints.requirement: Maintain a process to identify, track, and notify affected data subjects and relevant authorities of unauthorized use or disclosure (breach) of personal information.
constraints.check: Confirm an incident process defines breach detection, affected-party notification, and record-keeping of privacy incidents.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P6.3 / P6.5 / P6.6 (notification of unauthorized disclosure)

constraints.title: Quality of personal information
constraints.requirement: Maintain personal information that is accurate, complete, and relevant for the purposes for which it is used.
constraints.check: Verify controls exist to validate and update personal data (e.g. verification at entry, periodic review) so it stays accurate and relevant.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P7.1 (data quality)

constraints.title: Monitoring, enforcement, and complaint handling
constraints.requirement: Operate a process to receive, address, and resolve privacy-related inquiries, complaints, and disputes, and to monitor compliance with privacy commitments including corrective action.
constraints.check: Confirm a documented complaint/dispute intake and resolution process exists with monitoring, escalation, and corrective-action tracking.
constraints.source_ref: TSC Privacy P8.1 (monitoring and enforcement)

constraints.title: Processing specifications and objectives defined
constraints.requirement: Define and document the specifications for how data must be processed, including the objectives, expected outputs, and quality criteria, so completeness and accuracy can be measured against a known baseline.
constraints.applies_when: System processes, transforms, or computes data on behalf of users or customers, and Processing Integrity is in audit scope
constraints.check: Confirm there is documented processing specification (data dictionary, transformation rules, or functional spec) that states expected inputs, outputs, and quality thresholds for each processing flow
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.1 (quality information about processing objectives)

constraints.title: Input completeness controls
constraints.requirement: Ensure all expected inputs are captured and no records are lost at intake, for example via record counts, batch totals, or sequence checks at the point data enters the system.
constraints.applies_when: System ingests batches, feeds, or transactions from users or upstream systems
constraints.check: Verify the plan includes intake completeness controls (expected-vs-received record counts, batch control totals, or gap/sequence detection) that flag missing inputs
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.2 (inputs are complete)

constraints.title: Input validity and accuracy checks
constraints.requirement: Validate inputs for correct format, type, range, and business-rule conformance before processing, rejecting or quarantining data that fails so invalid values do not enter processing.
constraints.applies_when: System accepts external or user-supplied data that feeds processing logic
constraints.check: Confirm input validation rules (schema, type, range, referential/business-rule checks) exist and that invalid inputs are rejected or routed to an exception path rather than silently processed
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.2 (inputs are accurate and valid)

constraints.title: Authorised inputs and processing requests
constraints.requirement: Accept and process only inputs and processing requests that originate from authorised sources or authenticated actors, so unauthorised data cannot drive processing.
constraints.applies_when: System processes data submitted by identifiable users, tenants, or upstream integrations
constraints.check: Verify each processing entry point authenticates and authorises the source before accepting input (API keys, signed requests, role checks) and logs the originating identity
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.2 / PI1.3 (processing is authorised)

constraints.title: Processing completeness (no dropped records)
