constraints.requirement: Ensure every accepted input is processed exactly once and produces a corresponding result, so records are not dropped, skipped, or silently duplicated during processing.
constraints.applies_when: System runs multi-step, batched, or asynchronous processing pipelines
constraints.check: Confirm the pipeline reconciles input record counts to processed/output counts and detects dropped or duplicated records (idempotency keys, end-to-end counts)
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.3 (processing is complete)

constraints.title: Processing accuracy
constraints.requirement: Ensure processing produces correct results per the documented specifications, verified through automated calculations checks, test cases, or comparison to expected values.
constraints.applies_when: System performs calculations, transformations, or aggregations whose correctness matters
constraints.check: Verify there are automated correctness controls (unit/regression tests against expected outputs, checksum or control-total comparisons) covering the processing logic
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.3 (processing is accurate)

constraints.title: Processing timeliness
constraints.requirement: Ensure processing completes within the defined time windows or service levels, with monitoring that detects and alerts on delayed or stalled processing.
constraints.applies_when: System has time-sensitive processing, scheduled jobs, or committed SLAs
constraints.check: Confirm processing SLAs/schedules are defined and that latency or job-duration monitoring alerts when processing runs late or fails to complete on time
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.3 (processing is timely)

constraints.title: Processing error detection and remediation
constraints.requirement: Detect processing errors and exceptions, route failed items to an exception queue or dead-letter mechanism, and track them through resolution so failures are not lost.
constraints.applies_when: System runs automated processing that can partially fail
constraints.check: Verify failed or rejected items are captured in an exception/dead-letter queue with alerting and a documented remediation/reprocessing workflow
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.3 (identification and correction of processing errors)

constraints.title: Output completeness and accuracy verification
constraints.requirement: Verify that outputs are complete and accurate before release, for example by reconciling output totals or counts against inputs and expected results.
constraints.applies_when: System generates outputs, reports, files, or results consumed downstream or by customers
constraints.check: Confirm outputs are reconciled to inputs/expected values (control totals, record-count matching, validation of generated files) prior to delivery
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.4 (outputs are complete and accurate)

constraints.title: Timely delivery to authorised recipients
constraints.requirement: Deliver outputs only to authorised recipients and within the required timeframe, ensuring results are not disclosed to or accessible by unauthorised parties.
constraints.applies_when: System distributes processed outputs to specific users, tenants, or systems
constraints.check: Verify output delivery enforces recipient authorisation (access controls, tenant scoping) and meets defined delivery timing, with logging of what was delivered to whom
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.4 (outputs delivered to intended recipients timely)

constraints.title: Complete and accurate storage of inputs and outputs
constraints.requirement: Store processing inputs and outputs completely, accurately, and in a timely manner, protecting them from unauthorised or unintended alteration while retained.
constraints.applies_when: System persists processed data, inputs, or outputs for later use or retrieval
constraints.check: Confirm stored inputs/outputs are written durably with integrity protection (checksums, transactional writes, immutability or change controls) and match what was processed
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.5 (storage of inputs and outputs is complete, accurate, timely)

constraints.title: End-to-end reconciliation controls
constraints.requirement: Maintain reconciliation controls that trace data from input through processing to output and storage, so any imbalance in counts or totals is detected and investigated.
constraints.applies_when: System processes data across multiple stages or components where records could be lost or altered in transit
constraints.check: Verify an end-to-end reconciliation exists (input vs processed vs output vs stored counts/totals) with a defined process to investigate and resolve discrepancies
constraints.source_ref: SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria PI1.2-PI1.5 (completeness and accuracy across the processing lifecycle)
